multisig.note: One wallet from one 24-word seed; the app has no m-of-n or MuSig2 account (LND signing RPCs are never called)

hw_signer.note: Keys come from the on-phone seed; the generated lnd.conf has no remote signer and no device code exists in the app

psbt.note: Withdraw signs and broadcasts through LND sendCoins; there is no PSBT import, export or share

watch_only.note: Restore accepts a 24-word seed only; no xpub, descriptor or address import in the app

passphrase.note: Optional aezeed passphrase on create and restore; not BIP 39: a wrong one is rejected, it does not open another wallet

coin_control.note: sendCoins gets address, amount and fee rate only, no outpoints; no coin list in the app (LND would accept outpoints)

fee_bump.note: Bump Fee does CPFP on the change of a pending channel-open tx only; ordinary on-chain sends have no bump

taproot.note: Default receive address is P2TR (bc1p); long-pressing New Address gives P2WPKH

descriptors.note: On-chain screens are address, history, details and withdraw; no descriptor or xpub export or import

own_server.note: Settings > Bitcoin Node takes any BIP 157 peer. A bitcoind mode sits behind a hidden debug gate; the fee URL is fixed

verifies_chain.note: Embedded LND runs neutrino (BIP 157/158): headers and filters are checked on the phone, not a server's balances

tor.note: Experimental toggle starts embedded Tor; Bitcoin and LN peers use it, rates and mempool.space calls stay clearnet

seed_standard.note: 24-word aezeed phrase (LND), not BIP 39; BIP 39 wallets cannot restore it and the app cannot import a BIP 39 phrase

cloud_backup.note: iCloud backup holds encrypted channel state only (off-chain funds); on-chain funds restore from the written phrase
